opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000; will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel up to £2,000 (13 days or fewer) or £2,500 (14+ days) per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals for personal projects. PhD students must include a letter of support from their supervisor. UK-origin projects apply to UK office, Japan-origin to Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects bringing people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Covers festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language and cultural studies, and academic research/visits/exchange.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan. Applicants should normally show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Project must involve partners in both UK and Japan, supported by referees not based at the same institution as either partner. Preference to those new to UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. May be used for travel expenses, conference and publication costs.
